comment: The forge: what the three benches make, and what it costs. 'kind' is the bench it belongs to -- craft (gear), alchemy (pills and elixirs), cook (food). 'cost' is item id to how many. The server reads this file at start-up.

recipes.note: Skewer the tail, sear the meat. It feeds the body and warms the meridians.
Fat rendered slow over a bloodied tusk. It sits heavy and warm.
Marrow and a weak core, simmered down. Sharp, and it warms you through.
Dough folded around a core fragment, dyed with the alpha's blood. It tastes of qi, not flour.
Bone ground to powder, blood to bind it into a pellet.
A core steeped in beast blood until it glows dull red.
The tough hide over the soft, cured with its own fat and sewn close.
Hide boiled soft, a tusk split for the brow.
Soles thick enough to outlast a wolf's sprint.
Thin hide guards. A little defence, a little grip.
Reinforced at the knees, where the beast's claws land first.
Travel-worn, ash-stained. It hides nothing, but it catches the wind.
A tusk ground down to a practice blade. Every master kept one.
Planks and a tusk rim. Heavy, honest, and better than an open hand.
A knotted strip of dyed hide, worn at the brow.
A stone split by a thin seam of living qi. It hums when you breathe.
Jade with a corner broken off, set in the alpha's own pelt. Still cool against the sternum.
A plain copper band that sharpens the wearer's critical strikes.
The alpha's core spun into a ring that helps draw ambient Qi into the dantian.
Dense green jade that steadies the body and turns aside blows.
